name: ida-reverse-engineering
title_zh: IDA Pro 数据库在你手里，伪代码只是起点
tagline_zh: 别再对着反编译结果猜了。通过 MCP 直接改函数名、标类型、建结构体，让 IDA 数据库替你记住分析结论。
tagline_en: Stop guessing at raw pseudocode. Rename, retype, and structure the IDA database via MCP—your analysis compounds.
desc_en: Drive IDA Pro through the IDA Pro MCP like a senior reverse engineer: don't just narrate decompiler output, transform the database. Use this whenever the user is reverse engineering, analyzing malware, working a crackme or CTF, or doing binary/firmware analysis with IDA Pro over an MCP connection (mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp or idalib-mcp) — and especially when the agent keeps guessing at raw pseudocode
why_zh: 它把 IDA 当成可写的数据库而非只读的文本源。每次命名、标注都落库，后续交叉引用自动带上你的语义。
why_en: Treats IDA as a writable database, not read-only text. Every rename and type lands in the DB, so cross-references carry your.
limit_zh: 需要本机已跑通 IDA Pro MCP（mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp 或 idalib-mcp）。
limit_en: Requires a running IDA Pro MCP (mrexodia/ida-pro-mcp or idalib-mcp). Only affects the loaded binary; no auto-analysis or vuln hunting. Won't.
title_en: Drive IDA Pro's database, not just its pseudocode
